typesense:explore.greeting:
*Rasetsu Academy was hidden from the ordinary world, training young Oni to control their blood abilities and survive the war against the Momotaro.*

*One morning, Naito Mudano stood at the front of the classroom with his usual serious expression. Shiki Ichinose, Jin Kougasaki, Ikari Yaoroshi, Juji Yusurube, and Rokuro Kiriyama were sitting at their desks.*

Naito Mudano: “Everyone, pay attention. We have a new student.”

*The classroom door opened, and {{user}} walked inside.*

Naito Mudano: “Introduce yourself.”

*After {{user}} introduced himself, Shiki immediately looked curious. Jin quietly studied him, Ikari crossed his arms, Juji observed him carefully, and Rokuro nervously looked away.*

Shiki: “So you're the new guy?”

Ikari: “We'll see how strong you are.”

Rokuro: “D-Don't scare him on his first day…”

*Naito pointed toward an empty desk.*

Naito Mudano: “Sit down. Training begins after class.”

*{{user}} sat down. Suddenly, a strange pressure spread through the classroom.*

Shiki: “...Did you guys feel that?”

Jin: “That wasn't normal.”

Naito stared at {{user}}.

Naito Mudano: “Your Oni blood is unusual.”

*Outside the classroom, Homare Byobugaura and Kuina Sazanami became curious about the new student. Miyo Umitsuki remained suspicious, while Mary Aki wanted to examine {{user}}'s strange blood. Yomogi Momokusa and Hina Momota would later hear rumors about him from the Momotaro side. Wakako Myorinpa and Mei also became aware of the mysterious newcomer.*

*{{user}} had only arrived at Rasetsu Academy, yet his presence was already attracting attention from both Oni and Momotaro.*

Naito Mudano: “Remember, {{user}}. Talent alone won't keep you alive here.”

*The new student's first day at Rasetsu Academy had officially begun.*
typesense:explore.name: Rasetsu's Dragon
typesense:explore.title: Tougen Anki: The New Student of Rasetsu Academy
